datasets.name: Luding multi-modal landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: In the case of the lack of a large, high-quality multi-modal landslide dataset, we construct the Luding multi-modal landslide dataset by combining optical image data and PolSAR image data sourced from the Luding region.

datasets.name: GF-3 PolSAR images
datasets.verbatim: Table 1 shows the data set sensor type and acquisition time information... SAR 224 × 224 GF-3 8 m 2022/09/06

datasets.name: ZY-1 optical images
datasets.verbatim: Table 1 shows the data set sensor type and acquisition time information... OPT 224 × 224 ZY-1 2 m 2022/09/10

datasets.name: 12.5 m digital elevation model (DEM)
datasets.verbatim: A 12.5 m digital elevation model (DEM) ensure precise image alignment.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1 SAR data
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-1 offers freely accessible C-band SAR data... The Sentinel-1 images used in this study has a spatial resolution of 14.5 m and is acquired on 19 April 2025.

methods.name: Multi-modal cross Swin Transformer network (MCSTNet)
methods.summary: A multi-modal network for landslide detection based on multi-label classification. It consists of two stages: feature extraction using two independent Swin Transformer branches for optical and PolSAR images, and feature fusion using a multi-modal cross multi-head self-attention (MCMSA) mechanism.
methods.source: Yongxin Li, Yukun Xue, Zhihui Xin, Guisheng Liao, Penghui Huang
methods.verbatim: We also propose a multi-modal network for landslide detection based on multi-label classification, called multi-modal cross Swin Transformer network (MCSTNet).

availability.author_statement: "Data will be made available on request."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not linked or provided, and the custom MCSTNet code lacks a repository or persistent link.
